scripts.setup: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.emulators:fresh: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mycalendar --only auth,firestore,functions --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mycalendar --only auth,firestore,functions --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
